item.title: 10. Ronald Reagan—”Tear Down This Wall” (1987)
item.description: Standing before the Berlin Wall, Reagan issued one of the most memorable challenges of the Cold War. Addressing Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev directly, Reagan declared, “Mr. Gorbachev, tear down this wall.” The speech symbolized America’s commitment to freedom and its refusal to accept the division of Europe.
